exposure: Amniotic fluid concentrations of lactic acid, MMP-2, MMP-8, MMP-9, and IL-6
Occurrence of PPROM (preterm prelabour rupture of membranes)
in utero fetal surgery to correct incomplete closure of the spinal cord
In utero fetal surgery for open spinal defect
cohort: 24 pregnant women at 24-26 weeks of gestation who underwent in utero surgery to correct an open spinal defect in their fetus
finding: Higher amniotic fluid concentrations of MMP-8 and lactic acid were associated with PPROM in women who underwent in utero surgery for fetal open spinal defects.
